status.aboutToDelete: This data is about to be automatically removed from the system

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.subtitle: Hospital Appointments & Parking Management
appointments.emptyHint: Please go to "New Appointment" to add a new appointment, or check items moved to the "History" page
appointments.qrHint: Show this to the security guard to scan at the entrance
appointments.deleteConfirmText: Are you sure you want to delete the appointment of {name} (ID: {id})?
appointments.deleteConfirmNote: This item will be moved to the history page for {days} days. After that period it will be removed automatically — you can restore it before then.
appointments.deleteSuccess: Deleted and moved to history. It will be permanently removed after {days} days

history.guardEmptyHint: Items you scanned via QR or phone search will be recorded here
history.myEmptyHint: All of your appointments will appear here
history.purgeNoticeBanner: Deleted items stay in history for {days} days (1 month) and can be restored at any time during this period. After {days} days the data will be permanently removed and can no longer be restored.
history.restoreHint: Select rows to restore together, or restore all
history.emptyDeleted: No deleted or cancelled history items
history.emptyDeletedHint: Appointments removed from the appointments page will appear here
history.restoreConfirmText: Are you sure you want to restore the appointment of {name} (ID: {id}) back to the appointments page?
history.restoreConfirmNote: After restoring, the item status will change to "Backup" and it will immediately reappear on the appointments page. The permanent deletion countdown will stop (data will no longer be removed automatically).
history.batchRestoreText: Are you sure you want to restore all {count} appointments back to the appointments page?
history.batchRestoreNote: After restoring, all items will change to "Backup" and immediately reappear on the appointments page. The permanent deletion countdown will stop (data will no longer be removed automatically).
history.batchRestoreSuccess: Successfully restored {count} items! Status changed to "Backup"
